blocks.zh: 理解潔淨室確認（Qualification）的三階段流程：IQ、OQ、PQ 各自驗證什麼、如何銜接，以及 at-rest 與 in-operation 兩種狀態的差異。
blocks.en: Understand the three-stage cleanroom qualification process: what IQ, OQ and PQ each verify, how they connect, and how the at-rest and in-operation states differ.

blocks.zh: 掌握 Performance Qualification（PQ）的執行要點：為何需要三次連續運行、Extended PQ 如何涵蓋季節變異與微生物趨勢。
blocks.en: Grasp the key points of executing Performance Qualification (PQ): why three consecutive runs are needed, and how Extended PQ captures seasonal variation and microbial trends.

blocks.zh: 了解環境監控計畫的基本組成：清潔消毒、取樣點選擇、取樣頻率與方法如何構成整體污染控制策略。
blocks.en: Understand the basic components of an environmental monitoring program: how cleaning and disinfection, sample site selection, sampling frequency and methods together form the overall contamination control strategy.

blocks.zh: 學會 EM 取樣點選擇的生命週期方法（Lifecycle Approach）：從新設施啟動、EMPQ、例行監控到設施除役的全流程管理。
blocks.en: Learn the lifecycle approach to EM sample site selection: managing the whole path from new facility start-up, EMPQ and routine monitoring through to facility decommissioning.

blocks.zh: 理解 BioPhorum 六因子風險模型與網格剖析法（Grid Profiling）：如何透過 FMEA/HACCP 工具與六項風險因子進行系統化的取樣點風險評估。
blocks.en: Understand the BioPhorum six-factor risk model and grid profiling: how to use FMEA/HACCP tools and six risk factors to assess sample site risk systematically.

blocks.zh: 4.0 Environmental Monitoring Qualification of Cleanrooms 4.0 潔淨室的環境監測確效
blocks.en: 4.0 Environmental Monitoring Qualification of Cleanrooms

blocks.zh: TR13 Section 4.0 / 導讀
blocks.en: TR13 Section 4.0 / Overview

blocks.zh: 本節是潔淨室「從建造到可用」的關鍵確認流程。想像你蓋了一間新工廠——不是蓋好就能生產，必須經過「驗收三部曲」（IQ / OQ / PQ）確認環境真的夠乾淨。
blocks.en: This section covers the key qualification process that takes a cleanroom from "built" to "ready for use". Imagine you have built a new factory: it cannot start producing the moment construction ends. It must pass the "acceptance trilogy" (IQ / OQ / PQ) to confirm that the environment is genuinely clean enough.

blocks.zh: 工廠驗收比喻
blocks.en: Factory Acceptance Analogy

blocks.zh: 把潔淨室確認想像成「新房交屋驗收」：
blocks.en: Think of cleanroom qualification as the "handover inspection of a new house":

blocks.zh: IQ（安裝確認） = 驗收水電管線、門窗安裝是否正確——確認 HEPA 濾網、空調系統、儀器校正都到位。
blocks.en: IQ (Installation Qualification) = checking that the plumbing, wiring, doors and windows are installed correctly: confirming that the HEPA filters, HVAC system and instrument calibration are all in place.

blocks.zh: OQ（操作確認） = 開啟所有設備測試功能——確認空調能達到規定潔淨度等級。
blocks.en: OQ (Operational Qualification) = switching on all the equipment and testing its functions: confirming that the HVAC can achieve the specified cleanliness grade.

blocks.zh: PQ（性能確認） = 模擬日常生活看看房子是否堪用——在真實生產條件下連續測試，確認環境持續達標。
blocks.en: PQ (Performance Qualification) = simulating daily living to see whether the house is usable: testing continuously under real production conditions to confirm the environment consistently meets requirements.

blocks.zh: TR13 強調：新設施必須前瞻性（prospective）確認，不能先生產再補確認。既有設施若歷史數據良好，可與日常生產同步進行再確認，但產品放行必須等確認完成。
blocks.en: TR13 stresses that a new facility must be qualified prospectively; you cannot start production first and qualify afterwards. For an existing facility with good historical data, requalification may run concurrently with routine production, but product release must wait until qualification is complete.

blocks.zh: IQ / OQ Phases & At-Rest vs In-Operation IQ / OQ 階段及靜態與動態比較
blocks.en: IQ / OQ Phases & At-Rest vs In-Operation

blocks.zh: At-Rest vs In-Operation / 解析
blocks.en: At-Rest vs In-Operation / Analysis

blocks.zh: 理解這兩種狀態非常重要：At-rest 測試的是潔淨室的「硬體底線」——HVAC、HEPA 濾網、氣流設計能不能自己維持潔淨？In-operation 則加入人為因素——人是最大的微生物污染源，必須確認即使在最繁忙的生產狀態下，環境仍然達標。
blocks.en: It is important to understand these two states. At-rest tests the cleanroom's "hardware baseline": can the HVAC, HEPA filters and airflow design keep the room clean on their own? In-operation adds the human factor. People are the biggest source of microbial contamination, so you must confirm that the environment still meets requirements even in the busiest production state.

blocks.zh: TR13 的一個重要提醒：at-rest 測試時要盡量減少人員干擾，例如使用延時採樣器讓技術人員先離場再開始採樣。
blocks.en: An important reminder from TR13: during at-rest testing, keep personnel interference to a minimum, for example by using a delayed-start sampler so that technicians can leave the room before sampling begins.

blocks.zh: Performance Qualification (PQ) & Extended PQ 效能確效（PQ）與延伸 PQ
blocks.en: Performance Qualification (PQ) & Extended PQ

blocks.zh: PQ 三連續運行 / 深度解讀
blocks.en: PQ Three Consecutive Runs / In-Depth Interpretation

blocks.zh: PQ 的核心要求
blocks.en: Core PQ Requirements

blocks.zh: 3 次連續運行（Three Consecutive Runs）——證明環境不是「偶爾」達標，而是「穩定」達標。
blocks.en: Three Consecutive Runs: demonstrating that the environment meets requirements not "occasionally" but "consistently".

blocks.zh: 批次相關房間：每次運行 = 一個完整批次，涵蓋所有班次和活動。
blocks.en: Batch-related rooms: each run = one complete batch, covering all shifts and activities.

blocks.zh: 輔助區域：每次運行須涵蓋該區所有相關活動。
blocks.en: Support areas: each run must cover all relevant activities in that area.

blocks.zh: 取樣點 = 例行監控點 + 額外點位（涵蓋房間偏遠角落）。
blocks.en: Sample sites = routine monitoring sites + additional sites (covering remote corners of the room).

blocks.zh: PQ 限度 = 例行監控的 Action Limits（不是更寬鬆的標準）。
blocks.en: PQ limits = the Action Limits used in routine monitoring (not looser criteria).

blocks.zh: 比喻：餐廳試營運
blocks.en: Analogy: A Restaurant Soft Opening

blocks.zh: PQ 就像餐廳的「試營運」：不是空場測試設備（那是 OQ），而是真的讓廚師上場、客人入座、全流程跑三天。如果連續三天的衛生檢查都合格，才正式開幕。而 Extended PQ 就像試營運後再觀察幾個月，看看夏天蚊蟲多、冬天暖氣乾燥等季節變化是否會影響衛生狀態。
blocks.en: PQ is like a restaurant's "soft opening": it is not an empty-room equipment test (that is OQ), but a real trial with chefs at work, guests seated and the whole workflow running for three days. Only if the hygiene inspections pass on all three consecutive days does the restaurant open officially. Extended PQ is like continuing to observe for several months after the soft opening, to see whether seasonal changes, such as more insects in summer or dry indoor heating in winter, affect the hygiene status.

blocks.zh: 何時需要重新確認（Requalification）？
blocks.en: When Is Requalification Needed?

blocks.zh: 以下變更可能觸發重新確認：
blocks.en: The following changes may trigger requalification:

blocks.zh: 更衣程序變更
blocks.en: Changes to gowning procedures

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒程序調整
blocks.en: Adjustments to cleaning and disinfection procedures

blocks.zh: 房間佈局或設備重新配置
blocks.en: Changes to room layout or equipment reconfiguration

blocks.zh: 人流或物料流路徑改變
blocks.en: Changes to personnel flow or material flow paths

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：任何可能影響 EM 結果的變更，都需要重新評估潔淨室的確認狀態。
blocks.en: Key principle: any change that could affect EM results requires a re-evaluation of the cleanroom's qualification status.

blocks.zh: 5.0 Environmental Monitoring Program 5.0 環境監測計畫
blocks.en: 5.0 Environmental Monitoring Program

blocks.zh: EM 計畫總覽 / 中文解讀
blocks.en: EM Program Overview / Commentary

blocks.zh: Section 5.0 定義了環境監控計畫的「全景圖」。TR13 強調 EM 不是單純的「定期採樣」，而是一套完整的系統，包含：
blocks.en: Section 5.0 defines the "big picture" of the environmental monitoring program. TR13 stresses that EM is not simply "periodic sampling" but a complete system that includes:

blocks.zh: 人員——經過適當培訓且有授權
blocks.en: Personnel: appropriately trained and authorized

blocks.zh: 設備——已確認（qualified）且校正
blocks.en: Equipment: qualified and calibrated

blocks.zh: 培養基——已確認、製備、測試
blocks.en: Media: qualified, prepared and tested

blocks.zh: 程序——書面化、經核准、受控執行
blocks.en: Procedures: documented, approved and executed under control

blocks.zh: 方法——經過論證（justified）與確認
blocks.en: Methods: justified and validated

blocks.zh: EM 計畫的三大支柱
blocks.en: The Three Pillars of an EM Program

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒（Section 5.1）——降低微生物基線
blocks.en: Cleaning and disinfection (Section 5.1): reduces the microbial baseline

blocks.zh: 風險導向的取樣點選擇（Section 5.2）——在對的地方監測
blocks.en: Risk-based sample site selection (Section 5.2): monitoring in the right places

blocks.zh: 數據趨勢分析——持續檢視 alert/action 數據，驅動改善
blocks.en: Data trending: continuously reviewing alert/action data to drive improvement

blocks.zh: 注意 TR13 引用 ICH Q9 作為風險管理的框架基礎，這與 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 強調的污染控制策略（CCS）完全一致。
blocks.en: Note that TR13 cites ICH Q9 as the foundation of its risk management framework, which is fully consistent with the contamination control strategy (CCS) emphasized in EU GMP Annex 1 (2022).

blocks.zh: 5.1 Cleaning, Sanitization or Disinfection and Decontamination 5.1 清潔、衛生處理或消毒及去污染
blocks.en: 5.1 Cleaning, Sanitization or Disinfection and Decontamination

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒與 EM 的關係 / 解讀
blocks.en: Cleaning and Disinfection in Relation to EM / Commentary

blocks.zh: Section 5.1 的核心訊息很簡單但深刻：EM 數據是驗證清潔消毒效果的最直接證據。
blocks.en: The core message of Section 5.1 is simple but profound: EM data is the most direct evidence of the effectiveness of cleaning and disinfection.

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒確認的雙重驗證
blocks.en: Two-Part Verification of Cleaning and Disinfection Qualification

blocks.zh: 實驗室挑戰測試（Laboratory Challenge）：在實驗室用已知菌種接種於表面，測試消毒劑的殺菌效力與接觸時間。
blocks.en: Laboratory Challenge: inoculating surfaces with known organisms in the laboratory to test the disinfectant's antimicrobial efficacy and contact time.

blocks.zh: 現場驗證（In-situ Studies）：在實際製造環境中採樣，驗證清潔消毒程序在真實條件下的效果。
blocks.en: In-situ Studies: sampling in the actual manufacturing environment to verify how well the cleaning and disinfection procedures work under real conditions.

blocks.zh: 兩者缺一不可——實驗室數據證明「理論上有效」，現場數據證明「實際上有效」。
blocks.en: You need both: laboratory data shows the process is "effective in theory", while in-situ data shows it is "effective in practice".

blocks.zh: TR13 特別引用了 PDA TR70 和 USP <1072> 作為清潔消毒確認的方法學參考。如果你負責 EM 計畫，務必同時熟悉這兩份文件。
blocks.en: TR13 specifically cites PDA TR70 and USP <1072> as methodological references for qualifying cleaning and disinfection. If you are responsible for an EM program, make sure you are familiar with both documents.

blocks.zh: 5.2 EM Sample Site Selection Using Risk Management Principles 5.2 運用風险管理原則選定環境監測採樣點
blocks.en: 5.2 EM Sample Site Selection Using Risk Management Principles

blocks.zh: 風險導向取樣 / 核心理念
blocks.en: Risk-Based Sampling / Core Concept

blocks.zh: Section 5.2 是整個 TR13 最具方法論深度的章節之一。它回答一個根本問題：「在哪裡採樣？」不是憑經驗或慣例，而是透過系統化的風險評估來決定。
blocks.en: Section 5.2 is one of the most methodologically in-depth sections of TR13. It answers a fundamental question: "Where do we sample?" The answer comes not from experience or habit but from a systematic risk assessment.

blocks.zh: TR13 將這個過程分為兩大框架：
blocks.en: TR13 divides this process into two frameworks:

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 Lifecycle Approach——EM 計畫的「生命週期管理」
blocks.en: 5.2.1 Lifecycle Approach: "lifecycle management" of the EM program

blocks.zh: 5.2.2 QRM Process——用 FMEA / HACCP / BioPhorum 工具實際執行風險評估
blocks.en: 5.2.2 QRM Process: carrying out the risk assessment in practice with FMEA / HACCP / BioPhorum tools

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 Lifecycle Approach to an Environmental Monitoring Program 5.2.1 環境監測計畫的生命週期方法
blocks.en: 5.2.1 Lifecycle Approach to an Environmental Monitoring Program

blocks.zh: 生命週期方法 / 深度解讀
blocks.en: Lifecycle Approach / In-Depth Interpretation

blocks.zh: EM 計畫生命週期：五個階段
blocks.en: The EM Program Lifecycle: Five Stages

blocks.zh: 設計階段——定義取樣點、取樣類型、取樣量、取樣頻率
blocks.en: Design stage: define sample sites, sample types, sample volumes and sampling frequency

blocks.zh: EMPQ 階段——執行環境監控性能確認
blocks.en: EMPQ stage: perform the environmental monitoring performance qualification

blocks.zh: 例行監控階段——根據 PQ 結果調整（增減）取樣點，建立日常監控計畫
blocks.en: Routine monitoring stage: adjust (add or remove) sample sites based on PQ results and establish the routine monitoring program

blocks.zh: 變更管理——重大變更（重建、製程改變、設備搬遷）觸發重新評估
blocks.en: Change management: major changes (reconstruction, process changes, equipment relocation) trigger re-evaluation

blocks.zh: 除役階段——設施停用前的最終 EM 評估，證明控制維持到最後
blocks.en: Decommissioning stage: a final EM assessment before the facility is taken out of service, demonstrating that control was maintained to the end

blocks.zh: 比喻：車輛定期檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: Regular Vehicle Inspections

blocks.zh: 生命週期方法就像汽車的「終身保養計畫」：
blocks.en: The lifecycle approach is like a car's "lifetime maintenance plan":

blocks.zh: 新車交車檢查 = EMPQ（確認基線）
blocks.en: New-car delivery inspection = EMPQ (confirming the baseline)

blocks.zh: 定期保養 = 例行 EM（持續監控）
blocks.en: Regular servicing = routine EM (continuous monitoring)

blocks.zh: 改裝後重新檢測 = 變更後 requalification
blocks.en: Re-inspection after modifications = requalification after changes

blocks.zh: 報廢前最終檢驗 = 除役 EM 評估
blocks.en: Final inspection before scrapping = decommissioning EM assessment

blocks.zh: 重點是：不是確認一次就永遠沒事，而是持續評估、持續調整。
blocks.en: The point is that qualifying once does not make you safe forever; you must keep evaluating and keep adjusting.

blocks.zh: 特別注意 TR13 提到的「定期重新評估」：即使沒有重大變更，EM 計畫也應該定期檢討（例如因應不良趨勢報告），確保監控策略仍然適當。
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to the "periodic reassessment" mentioned in TR13: even without major changes, the EM program should be reviewed periodically (for example in response to adverse trend reports) to ensure the monitoring strategy remains appropriate.

blocks.zh: 5.2.2 Initiation of Quality Risk Management Process 5.2.2 品質風险管理流程的啟動
blocks.en: 5.2.2 Initiation of Quality Risk Management Process

blocks.zh: QRM 流程啟動 / 中文解析
blocks.en: QRM Process Initiation / Commentary

blocks.zh: 風險評估前的四個必備要素
blocks.en: Four Essential Elements Before a Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 範圍與目標（Scope & Objective）——評估哪個區域/製程
blocks.en: Scope & Objective: which area/process is being assessed

blocks.zh: 風險問題（Risk Question）——要回答什麼問題
blocks.en: Risk Question: what question needs to be answered

blocks.zh: 風險管理工具（Tool）——FMEA、HACCP 或 BioPhorum toolkit
blocks.en: Risk management tool: FMEA, HACCP or the BioPhorum toolkit

blocks.zh: 風險排序準則（Risk-Ranking Criteria）——如何量化風險高低
blocks.en: Risk-ranking criteria: how risk levels are quantified

blocks.zh: 跨部門團隊是 TR13 反覆強調的要求。EM 風險評估不是微生物實驗室單獨的工作，需要涵蓋：微生物學、污染控制、品質工程、設施維護、QC、QA 和製造部門。
blocks.en: A cross-functional team is a requirement TR13 emphasizes repeatedly. An EM risk assessment is not the microbiology laboratory's job alone; it needs to involve microbiology, contamination control, quality engineering, facility maintenance, QC, QA and manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Process Mapping 的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Process Mapping

blocks.zh: 在開始風險評估之前，團隊必須先到現場走訪（Gemba Walk），用房間佈局圖標示：
blocks.en: Before starting the risk assessment, the team must first conduct a Gemba Walk on site and mark the following on a room layout drawing:

blocks.zh: 設備位置
blocks.en: Equipment locations

blocks.zh: 人員動線（People Flow）
blocks.en: People flow

blocks.zh: 物料動線（Material Flow）
blocks.en: Material flow

blocks.zh: 廢棄物動線（Waste Flow）
blocks.en: Waste flow

blocks.zh: 這個步驟的目的是讓團隊「用眼睛看、用腳走」，而不是在會議室裡憑記憶做評估。
blocks.en: The purpose of this step is for the team to "see with their own eyes and walk it with their own feet", rather than assessing from memory in a meeting room.

blocks.zh: BioPhorum EM Risk Assessment Toolkit 是製藥業界合作開發的標準化工具，提供逐步指引來建立 EM 計畫，已被越來越多公司採用。
blocks.en: The BioPhorum EM Risk Assessment Toolkit is a standardized tool developed collaboratively by the pharmaceutical industry. It provides step-by-step guidance for building an EM program and is being adopted by a growing number of companies.

blocks.zh: 5.2.2.1 General Points to Consider & Grid Profiling 5.2.2.1 一般考量事項與網格分佈量測
blocks.en: 5.2.2.1 General Points to Consider & Grid Profiling

blocks.zh: 六因子風險模型與網格剖析 / 深度解讀
blocks.en: Six-Factor Risk Model and Grid Profiling / In-Depth Interpretation

blocks.zh: 比喻：城市犯罪熱點分析
blocks.en: Analogy: Crime Hotspot Analysis in a City

blocks.zh: Grid Profiling 就像警方用網格將城市劃分區塊，然後根據多個因子（人口密度、夜間照明、歷史犯案率...）為每個區塊打分數，分數越高的區塊派越多巡邏。
blocks.en: Grid profiling is like the police dividing a city into blocks with a grid, then scoring each block on several factors (population density, night-time lighting, historical crime rate, and so on). The higher a block's score, the more patrols it gets.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室的「犯罪」就是微生物污染，六個風險因子就是評估每個網格「容易出事」程度的指標。
blocks.en: In a cleanroom, the "crime" is microbial contamination, and the six risk factors are the indicators of how "likely to go wrong" each grid cell is.

blocks.zh: Grid Size 建議
blocks.en: Grid Size Recommendations

blocks.zh: Grade A: 0.5 m² per grid（最精細，因為是最關鍵區域）
blocks.en: Grade A: 0.5 m² per grid (the finest, because it is the most critical area)

blocks.zh: Grade B–D: 依區域大小和製程複雜度調整（TR13 Appendix 2 有詳細範例）
blocks.en: Grade B–D: adjust according to area size and process complexity (TR13 Appendix 2 gives detailed examples)

blocks.zh: 將網格組合成「功能區段」（如灌裝區、加蓋區）可以讓取樣點的定義更有意義，而不是機械式地每格都採。
blocks.en: Combining grid cells into "functional sections" (such as the filling area or capping area) makes the definition of sample sites more meaningful, rather than mechanically sampling every cell.

blocks.zh: TR13 Section 5.2.2.1 還列出了七大類考量因素，其中特別值得注意的是：
blocks.en: TR13 Section 5.2.2.1 also lists seven categories of considerations, of which the following are particularly worth noting:

blocks.zh: 厭氧菌監控：嚴格厭氧菌在好氧潔淨室中不太可能存活，但微需氧菌如 Cutibacterium acnes（原 Propionibacterium acnes）可能被標準好氧培養遺漏，應進行定期/調查性監控。
blocks.en: Anaerobe monitoring: strict anaerobes are unlikely to survive in an aerobic cleanroom, but microaerophilic organisms such as Cutibacterium acnes (formerly Propionibacterium acnes) may be missed by standard aerobic culture, so periodic/investigational monitoring should be performed.

blocks.zh: 煙霧研究（Smoke Studies）：氣流可視化可以發現紊流和渦流區域，這些區域可能需要透過氣流、製程或設施重新設計來處理。
blocks.en: Smoke Studies: airflow visualization can reveal turbulence and eddy zones, which may need to be addressed through redesign of the airflow, process or facility.

blocks.zh: BioPhorum 六因子風險評分模型
blocks.en: BioPhorum Six-Factor Risk Scoring Model

blocks.zh: 注意：因子 4「與產品的距離」權重特別高（Medium=4, High=8），因為這是對產品品質最直接的威脅。
blocks.en: Note: Factor 4, "proximity to product", carries a particularly high weight (Medium=4, High=8), because it is the most direct threat to product quality.

blocks.zh: 風險分級：六因子得分相乘
blocks.en: Risk classification: the scores of the six factors are multiplied together

blocks.zh: 5.2.2.2–5.2.2.4 Risk Initiation, Assessment, Control & Review 5.2.2.2–5.2.2.4 風险啟動、評估、管制與審查
blocks.en: 5.2.2.2–5.2.2.4 Risk Initiation, Assessment, Control & Review

blocks.zh: 風險評估執行流程 / 完整解讀
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Execution Process / Full Interpretation

blocks.zh: EM 風險評估的八步驟流程
blocks.en: The Eight-Step EM Risk Assessment Process

blocks.zh: 繪製房間佈局圖，疊加網格，組合為功能區段
blocks.en: Draw the room layout, overlay the grid, and combine cells into functional sections

blocks.zh: 團隊現場走訪，逐格記錄製程活動
blocks.en: Team Gemba Walk, recording process activities cell by cell

blocks.zh: 逐格評分，對照六因子計算風險分數
blocks.en: Score cell by cell, calculating the risk score against the six factors

blocks.zh: 按功能區段彙總，選定取樣位置與方法
blocks.en: Summarize by functional section, and select sampling locations and methods

blocks.zh: 建立 EMPQ 計畫
blocks.en: Establish the EMPQ plan

blocks.zh: 評估 EMPQ 結果
blocks.en: Evaluate the EMPQ results

blocks.zh: 確定例行 EM 取樣位置、方法與頻率
blocks.en: Determine routine EM sampling locations, methods and frequencies

blocks.zh: 定期回顧風險評估
blocks.en: Review the risk assessment periodically

blocks.zh: 常見陷阱警告
blocks.en: Common Pitfall Warning

blocks.zh: TR13 特別提醒：如果既有 EM 計畫沒有風險評估基礎，團隊在補做風險評估時，不能倒推來合理化現有的取樣計畫。必須從頭開始走現場（Gemba Walk）、做製程對應，客觀重新評估。
blocks.en: TR13 specifically warns: if an existing EM program has no risk assessment basis, the team performing a retrospective risk assessment must not work backwards to justify the existing sampling plan. They must start from scratch, walking the site (Gemba Walk), performing process mapping, and reassessing objectively.

blocks.zh: 同時要注意：不能因為風險評估結果說「低風險」就移除歷史上曾有不良回收趨勢的取樣點——歷史數據是重要的參考依據。
blocks.en: Also note that you must not remove a sample site that has historically shown adverse recovery trends just because the risk assessment concludes "low risk"; historical data is an important reference.

blocks.zh: 風險控制與回顧（Section 5.2.2.4）
blocks.en: Risk Control and Review (Section 5.2.2.4)

blocks.zh: 風險評估不是「做一次就好」的活動。TR13 要求：
blocks.en: A risk assessment is not a "do it once and you are done" activity. TR13 requires:

blocks.zh: 定期檢查原始評估的假設條件是否仍然成立
blocks.en: Periodically check whether the assumptions of the original assessment still hold

blocks.zh: 如有差異，重新排序危害等級
blocks.en: If there are differences, re-rank the hazard levels

blocks.zh: 如風險超出容許範圍，定義緩解措施
blocks.en: If risk exceeds the acceptable level, define mitigation measures

blocks.zh: 重大偏差必須納入考量並採取行動
blocks.en: Significant deviations must be considered and acted upon

blocks.zh: 比喻：保險精算的持續更新
blocks.en: Analogy: Continuous Updating of Insurance Actuarial Models

blocks.zh: 風險評估就像保險公司的精算模型——不能用十年前的數據定今天的保費。環境在變（新設備、新人員、新製程），風險模型也必須跟著更新。TR13 強調的「定期回顧」就是確保你的風險模型永遠反映現實。
blocks.en: A risk assessment is like an insurance company's actuarial model: you cannot set today's premium with ten-year-old data. The environment changes (new equipment, new personnel, new processes), so the risk model must be updated accordingly. The "periodic review" emphasized in TR13 ensures that your risk model always reflects reality.

blocks.zh: 新 EM 計畫（無歷史數據時）：團隊需要依靠科學經驗和主題專家知識來最小化評估中的不確定性。隨著例行監控數據的累積，實際風險水平會逐漸顯現。
blocks.en: For a new EM program (with no historical data): the team needs to rely on scientific experience and subject matter expert knowledge to minimize uncertainty in the assessment. As routine monitoring data accumulates, the actual risk level will gradually become apparent.

blocks.zh:
IQ/OQ/PQ 的關係：請說明為什麼 PQ 必須在 OQ 成功完成後才能進行？TR13 允許的「business risk approach」例外是什麼？
提示：參考 TR13 Section 4.0，PQ 可以在 OQ 完整結果出來之前開始，但前提是已有初步結果，且 PQ protocol 必須列明哪些 OQ 結果需要在 PQ 開始前到位。
blocks.en:
Relationship between IQ/OQ/PQ: Explain why PQ must be performed only after OQ has been successfully completed. What is the "business risk approach" exception that TR13 allows?
Hint: See TR13 Section 4.0. PQ may begin before the complete OQ results are available, provided preliminary results exist and the PQ protocol states which OQ results must be in place before PQ starts.

blocks.zh:
At-Rest vs In-Operation：一位 QA 主管問你：「為什麼 at-rest 的微生物限度反而比 in-operation 更嚴格？」你如何解釋？
提示：At-rest 排除了人為因素，測試的是環境的本底潔淨度。如果連無人狀態都不達標，有人時只會更差。
blocks.en:
At-Rest vs In-Operation: A QA manager asks you, "Why are the at-rest microbial limits actually stricter than the in-operation limits?" How would you explain it?
Hint: At-rest excludes the human factor and tests the background cleanliness of the environment. If the environment fails even when empty, it can only be worse when people are present.

blocks.zh:
六因子風險評分：某 Grade A 灌裝區的一個網格，六因子評估結果分別為：清潔可及性=Medium(2)、人員流動=High(4)、物料流動=Medium(2)、產品距離=High(8)、操作複雜度=High(4)、操作頻率=Medium(2)。請計算該網格的風險分數，並判斷風險等級。
計算：2 x 4 x 2 x 8 x 4 x 2 = 1,024 → High Risk (512–8,192)
blocks.en:
Six-factor risk scoring: For one grid cell in a Grade A filling area, the six-factor assessment gives: cleaning accessibility = Medium (2), personnel flow = High (4), material flow = Medium (2), product proximity = High (8), operational complexity = High (4), operational frequency = Medium (2). Calculate the risk score for this cell and determine the risk level.
Calculation: 2 x 4 x 2 x 8 x 4 x 2 = 1,024 → High Risk (512–8,192)

blocks.zh:
Lifecycle Approach 應用：你的工廠即將進行一條灌裝線的設備搬遷（從 A 棟搬到 B 棟），請根據 TR13 Section 5.2.1 的生命週期方法，列出需要執行的 EM 相關步驟。
提示：評估變更影響 → 重新進行風險評估 → 可能需要 requalification（IQ/OQ/PQ）→ 建立新的例行 EM 計畫。
blocks.en:
Applying the Lifecycle Approach: Your plant is about to relocate a filling line (from Building A to Building B). Based on the lifecycle approach in TR13 Section 5.2.1, list the EM-related steps that need to be carried out.
Hint: Assess the impact of the change → repeat the risk assessment → requalification (IQ/OQ/PQ) may be needed → establish a new routine EM program.

blocks.zh:
Gemba Walk 的目的：TR13 為什麼強調「既有 EM 計畫補做風險評估時不能倒推合理化」？這對 QA 審計有什麼實務意涵？
提示：如果風險評估只是為了替既有做法「背書」，就失去了發現潛在風險的能力。審計時應檢查風險評估是否有獨立的現場走訪紀錄。
blocks.en:
Purpose of the Gemba Walk: Why does TR13 emphasize that a retrospective risk assessment of an existing EM program must not work backwards to justify it? What are the practical implications for QA audits?
Hint: If a risk assessment is done only to "endorse" existing practice, it loses its ability to uncover latent risks. During an audit, check whether the risk assessment has independent records of a Gemba Walk.
